description: Use when an agent needs a one-answer summary of the last 8 hours in BTC, ETH, SOL and HYPE. Returns the items ranked by how abnormal each is: price move against the coin's own usual 8-hour move, funding, open interest, liquidations (total, long/short split, biggest print), Fear and Greed, today's macro releases with UTC times, and the nearest liquidation cluster as the level to watch. A stale source is left out and named; with no sampler it answers 503, never billed. Costs 0.03 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
